import sys

def find_path(n, p):
    path = [n]
    current = n
    while current != 1:
        current = p[current - 2]
        path.append(current)
    path.reverse()
    return path

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()

    p = list(map(int, data[1:]))
